closure_rule.expression: binary_closure_status == CLOSED AND test_status == PASSED_LOCAL AND verification_level == RUNTIME_VERIFIED
closure_rule.repo_remediated_runtime_pending_definiti: REPO_REMEDIATED_RUNTIME_PENDING: criterio probado con inyección de fallo/concurrencia en repo; el cierre binario requiere drill, receipts o evidencia de runtime desplegado.
closure_rule.description: Binary closure is counted only when the row is CLOSED, its local test status is PASSED_LOCAL and runtime verification is present. REPO_REMEDIATED_RUNTIME_PENDING means the repository criterion passed fault/concurrency injection, but final-SHA deployed drills, receipts or runtime evidence are still mandatory; local evidence never closes an OTR by itself.
